name: joint-network-calibration-v1
scope: Full-year in-sample finite calibration of supply bids, wind availability and effective AC ratings; not a recovered physical grid or actual bids
network_rule: Multiply the existing static symmetric AC branch MW limits, globally or on branches with either endpoint in NO/SE/FI/DK. Existing 0.7 rating multiplier becomes 0.595 or 0.805. Preserve susceptance/PTDF, topology, static nameplate GSK, offsets, islands, HVDC bounds and losses. These are experimental effective headroom bounds, not observed JAO domains, N-1 proof or physical expansion.
wind_rule: Multiply original source wind available MW by the declared scalar before aggregating existing offer groups; preserve hourly weather shape, source nominal MW and country membership. Update quantity-allocation availability consistently. This is a bounded profile/derating calibration hypothesis, not an IRENA capacity correction, measured outage or dispatch substituted for availability. No target-derived hourly profile.
fixed: Demand, hydro/water chronology, nuclear/solar/other availability, nameplates, grouping, topology, susceptance, original GSK, links, islands, offsets, monthly fuel anchors and each chosen bid anchor are unchanged. No new bid fit, arbitrary per-hour constraint fit or retired hydro/search restart.
regularization: Old availability-weighted bid penalty against accepted bids plus mean square of [wind deviation/0.1, mean AC deviation/0.15] over three coordinates: wind, Nordic-incident AC, remaining AC. Coordinate departures are counted even if a region is small. All deviation directions are relative to accepted source inputs.
selection: Lowest eligible regularized score over exactly the declared finite states, ties lower penalty then ordinal. Retain every failed or adverse state. Reuse the two hash-verified unchanged-physics annual witnesses. No adaptive range expansion or automatic baseline promotion.
observations: All41 complete A44 observed-price zones, all48 modeled areas, Ember monthly national five-fuel generation and signed net exports with original missingness. Implied export is not physical border flow; no verified hourly JAO/ENTSO-E border-flow fit in this trial.
acceptance: Independent modified-source allocation, component-native physics, primal/dual, quantity, metric and selection replay. Research filters are not product acceptance gates; no forecast, posterior, true capacity, investment-value or browser integration claim.
rejection_policy: Amended after the first tightened-AC control reported Infeasible: reject a full-year candidate at its first numerically certified infeasible hour, saving a Farkas row ray for independent replay; no annual metric for rejected/partial cases. Uncertified failures remain unresolved. Every selectable case still needs all8760 optimal hours and original no-emergency/quantity gates. Finite parameter grid/objective unchanged. Reuse the complete first wind control with interrupted-producer provenance rather than rerunning it.
